description: Keyword search across modules and skills. Matches a module on its id, name, type, engine, genre, summary, description, what it 'provides', and tags — so you can find a ready module by the feature you need (e.g. 'dice board', 'idle income', 'voxel building') rather than by name. Skills match on name and description. Returns the matching catalog entries.
name: search
title: Search modules and skills
